headline: S&P Maintains Credit Rating of Morocco Phosphate Producer OCP at BBB-
summary: S&P Global Ratings affirmed the BBB- credit rating of Moroccan state-owned phosphate producer OCP Group while projecting profit margins could decline toward 15% as leverage increases.
why: OCP Group is one of the world's largest exporters of phosphate rock and derivative fertilizers.

impacts.name: OCP Group
impacts.why: S&P affirmed OCP's BBB- credit rating while forecasting lower profit margins.
